title: Spotify: Music Without Owning It
description: Learn Spotify: Music Without Owning It in one minute.

hook.text: Napster showed people wanted digital music. Spotify showed them they didn't need to own it.

buildup.text: For a monthly fee, listeners got access to millions of songs instantly, legally.

discovery.text: Playlists replaced albums. Algorithmic discovery introduced listeners to artists they'd never find.

twist.text: Artists complained that Spotify pays fractions of a penny per stream. The economics are brutal.

climax.text: Spotify transformed music from a product you buy into a service you rent.

punchline.text: Streaming replaced ownership for a generation.

quiz.question: What did Spotify change about music consumption?
